verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents CLI commands (build, serve, test, lint) but contains no first-party or independent evidence describing the quality or clarity of error messages produced by the dev server or build tool. One old community comment (angular-comm-3) even notes that typos historically failed silently rather than producing clear compile errors, but this is from a 2016 Angular 2 alpha context and not tied to a current vendor claim, so it doesn't constitute a dispute—just an absence of supporting evidence.
